seo_title: About Frnds — pizzeria and coffee shop on Astana's left bank
seo_description: Frnds is a pizzeria and coffee shop at Sagadat Nurmagambetov 25, Astana. Our own dough, specialty coffee, breakfast all day, 09:00–23:00, every day.
intro: A small pizzeria and coffee shop on the left bank of Astana. Come by the way you'd come by a friend's — no occasion, no reservation, in whatever you're wearing.
body:
The name came easily: friends, just shorter. We never wanted a restaurant you visit for special occasions. We wanted a home away from home — somewhere you drop into for no reason at all, on your own or with everyone you know. Where you don't have to sit up straight and talk quietly, where you can turn up on a Sunday half-awake and nobody blinks. Where they recognize you the second time and remember which coffee you take. Seems to be working: 4.9 on 2GIS, and guests we know by name.

Our menu says it in Kazakh: “Бруклиннен шабыт алып, Астанада пісіреміз” — inspired by Brooklyn, baked in Astana. Brooklyn here isn't about exposed brick, it's about the approach: simple things done well. Pizza, coffee, breakfast — nothing extra, but each of them properly in its place. And we cook in Astana, on the left bank, for people who live around the corner and stop in on the way home. That matters more than any reference.

You can stay as long as you like. Nobody will hover to hint that the table is wanted. Work on your laptop, wait for the friend who's forty minutes late, finish the conversation long after the plates have gone. And if you want breakfast at nine in the evening — order breakfast. We serve it from open to close: eggs, syrniki, toast, any hour, because morning runs on a different clock for everyone. Come by — Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street 25, every day from nine in the morning to eleven at night.

values.title: The dough is ours
values.text: We make the dough ourselves, fresh every day. Everything rests on it: whether the pizza is just food, or the thing you come back for a week later.

values.title: Coffee and the bar list
values.text: The coffee is specialty and we stand behind it. Next to it: our own teas, lemonades, smoothies and milkshakes. The list is long not for show — people just feel like different things.

values.title: The ones who come back
values.text: We remember our regulars and usually already know what to bring. If something isn't right, say so straight away — we'll redo it, no long explanations.
